visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens inside an airplane cabin showing a seatback entertainment screen with a colorful Snoopy "Welcome Onboard" graphic for Osaka. The camera then cuts to the exterior of Kansai Airport Station under a clear blue sky, showing the modern architectural lines of the station entrance and sign. (2) A view from a moving train window shows Japanese urban residential buildings under an overcast sky. The shot cuts to a sleek, dark blue aerodynamic train arriving at a station platform where several people stand with suitcases. Then, the exterior of Nankai Namba Station is shown with pedestrians walking across the paved plaza. (3) The video moves inside a hotel room at GRIDS PREMIUM HOTEL, showcasing two neatly made twin beds with white linens, a wall-mounted TV, and a wooden-accented bathroom featuring a clean white bathtub, sink, and toilet. The lighting is warm and soft, creating a comfortable indoor atmosphere. (4) In a dimly lit restaurant called NEXT SHIKAKU, a chef in blue gloves prepares ramen. A bowl of ramen with a thick, creamy broth, soft-boiled eggs, seaweed, and pork slices is presented. Another shot shows a bowl with a clearer broth and a delicate purple flower garnish, followed by two pieces of seared wagyu sushi on a blue plate. (5) The scene shifts to the bustling Namba shopping district. The grand, historical facade of the Takashimaya department store is seen from the street. Inside, the camera pans across rows of sneakers and colorful clothing hanging on racks. A wide shot shows the modern exterior of the Namba Parks complex with its layered, curved architecture. (6) Inside the EDION electronics store, various tech products like hair dryers are displayed on shelves. A customer’s hand holds a receipt near a large suitcase, indicating a luggage storage service. The scene is brightly lit with typical retail studio lighting. (7) The viewer is taken to the Namba Walk underground shopping street, filled with small boutiques and grocery-style displays of colorful snacks and household goods. A Muji 500 storefront is shown with baskets of organized products. The video returns briefly to a train window view before transitioning. (8) The final sequence features on-screen graphics with red and white boxes summarizing travel deals. These overlays mention Visa, Agoda, Trip.com, and Expedia over background shots of the Namba station exterior and signs. The camera work is steady, using straight cuts to transition between different travel highlights.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 14:00 抵達關西機場. [Slogan]: 這次班機時間還不錯, 抵達時間滿早的! [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Subtitle]: 入境後搭南海電鐵直接到難波. [Slogan]: 座位舒服、速度又快, 我幾乎都是搭這個. (建議提前買票劃位). (3) [Subtitle]: 飯店 check in. [Logo]: GRIDS PREMIUM HOTEL OSAKA NAMBA. [Slogan]: 飯店離地鐵站超近, 走路3分鐘就到. 整體簡約乾淨, 我覺得還不錯. 刷 Visa 用 Agoda 訂房最高有 7% 優惠! (4) [Subtitle]: 進食時間. [Logo]: NEXT SHIKAKU. [Slogan]: 我們點了兩款, 牡蠣味都超濃厚. 湯頭鮮美到不行, 喜歡牡蠣的一定要給他機會. 他們的和牛壽司也長得很浮誇. (5) [Subtitle]: 逛街. [Logo]: 難波商圈. [Slogan]: 吃飽就開逛啦! 難波這一區百貨超多, 有些還是互通的喔. (6) [Subtitle]: 任意留言領取難波必逛清單. [Slogan]: 下雨天也不用怕, 照樣可以逛到腿軟! (7) [Subtitle]: EDION (愛電王) 難波本店. [Slogan]: 難波 EDION 很大間, 一共 9 層樓. 電器、美妝、玩具、日本酒、食品通通有. 它還有提供行李寄放只要 80 日圓的服務. (需出示專屬優惠券，請留言領取). (8) [Subtitle]: 難波地下街 (Namba Walk). [Slogan]: 新整修的難波地下街也不要錯過了. 和車站連通逛街超方便. (9) [Slogan]: 現在大阪很多地鐵都可以直接刷 Visa 進站. 日本旅遊刷 Visa 還有額外優惠唷!!! TableCheck 預訂東京、京阪 40 間精選餐廳 享 Dine with Visa 優惠 9 折. Agoda 刷 Visa 訂房，最高享 7% 優惠. Trip.com 機票、飯店折扣高達 $3,400 商務卡再享樂園門票買 1 送 1. Expedia 刷 Visa 並輸入優惠碼 「VISAYRO」 享 8% 優惠.
